Type: bistro-style wooden dining chair
Use: dining, sitting at a table; dining room, kitchen
Style: Scandinavian, classic, modern
Materials: solid wood frame with a black painted finish, curved wooden backrest
Colors: black, matte black
Shape: wide curved backrest panel on two rear posts, rounded seat, four slim round legs joined by a ring stretcher, bentwood café look, light and open
Feel: graphic, crisp, simple, timeless
Goes with: light wood or white tables, white walls, brass or black accents; Scandinavian kitchens, modern bistro-style dining rooms
